claims.text: The complexity and emergent autonomy of Generative AI systems introduce challenges in predictability and legal compliance.
The existing and proposed EU legislative framework contains potential gaps and shortcomings regarding Generative AI.

evidence.description: The paper states that complexity and emergent autonomy of Generative AI systems introduce challenges in predictability and legal compliance.
The paper identifies potential gaps and shortcomings in the EU legislative framework, including the Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA).

methodologies.name: EU Regulatory Analysis
methodologies.description: Legal analysis evaluating existing and proposed EU legislation across liability, privacy, intellectual property, and cybersecurity regarding Generative AI and LLMs.
conditions: Generative AI and Large Language Models

limitations.text: The analysis is constrained specifically to the European Union legal and regulatory context.
Existing and proposed EU legislation, including the Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA), contains potential gaps and shortcomings in addressing Generative AI challenges.
